facts.statement: The specific name zouhri honors the Moroccan paleontologist Samir Zouhri.
facts.quote: The specific name honours the Moroccan paleontologist Samir Zouhri.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen FSAC-KK 5004 was found in the Kem Kem Beds and dates to the Albian to early Cenomanian.
facts.quote: The holotype, FSAC-KK 5004, had been found in the Kem-Kem Beds, dating from the Albian - early Cenomanian.

facts.statement: The holotype fossil was deposited in the collection of the Département de Géologie at the Faculté des Sciences Aïn Chock.
facts.quote: Martill deposited the fossil in the collection of the Département de Géologie (Paléontologie), Faculté des Sciences Aïn Chock.

facts.statement: Afrotapejara lived during the late Cretaceous, approximately 98 to 92.5 million years ago in the Cenomanian, in what is now Africa.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente de 98 a 92.5 millones de años, durante el Cenomaniano, en lo que hoy es África.

facts.statement: The genus Afrotapejara was established by Martill et al. in 2020 with the type species Afrotapejara zouhri.
facts.quote: taxon: Afrotapejara authority: Martill et al., 2020 type_species: Afrotapejara zouhri type_species_authority: Martill et al., 2020

facts.statement: Afrotapejara belongs to the family Tapejaridae.
Afrotapejara is distinguished from other tapejarids by a dorsal expansion of the front margin of the snout located a short distance from the tip.
facts.quote: Afrotapejara is distinguished from all other tapejarids by the possession of a dorsal (upwards) expansion of the rostral (front) margin a short distance from the rostral tip.

facts.statement: The palate has a small boss located at the rear on the midline.
facts.quote: The palate shows a small boss at the rear, on the midline.

facts.statement: CT scans revealed that a bone fragment from another taxon was used to repair damage on the upper edge of the holotype snout.
facts.quote: The piece had already been prepared by the fossil traders. Subsequent preparation by Martill, as well as a CT scan, showed that a bone fragment from some other taxon had been used to repair damage to the upper edge.

facts.statement: Afrotapejara lived from the Albian to the Cenomanian, between 106.3 and 93.9 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Albian to Cenomanian (106.3 to 93.9 million years ago)
